name: Kael
note:
Kael Ashveil, 19 tahun, anak ketiga dari 4 bersaudara.
Ayah: keturunan Hero of Shadow. Ibu: keturunan Hero of Flame.
Kedua kakaknya condong ke api, sedangkan Kael dan adiknya condong ke shadow.
Awalnya belajar sebagai Mage, lalu berkembang menjadi Shadow Wizard.
profile:
Kaelen Ashveil, 19. Third of four children of the Ashveil house,
heir to both the Hero of Shadow and the Hero of Flame.

name: Yuki
note:
Yuki Ryuzetsu, 19 tahun, wanita dari Benua Timur.
Mengembara ke Benua Barat untuk mencari kakaknya
Bertarung menggunakan katana dan mengandalkan kecepatan.
profile:
Ryuzetsu Yuki, 19. A swordswoman from the Eastern Continent,
wandering the West in search of her missing brother

name: Aera
note: Aera Moonvale, 18 tahun. Teman seangkatan Kael di Akademi. Mage murni: elemen, heal, support.
profile:
Aera Moonvale, 18. A cheerful prodigy of the Royal Academy.
Born to the house Moonvale, a forgotten side-lined mage family

name: Diana
note: Diana, 26 tahun. Ranger hutan, pemburu yang pendiam dan sangat akurat.
profile:
Diana Hartwell, 27. A ranger of the deep forest.
Former archer of the Royal Kingdom. A shrouded mystery surrounds her

name: Roland
note: Cedric, 33 tahun. Ksatria kerajaan, pelindung party.
profile:
Roland Talonheart, 32. A loyal knight commander sworn to protect the Royal Kingdom..
Stands firm where others would fall.

name: Barion
note: Barion, 30 tahun. Pemburu naga, sudah membunuh 4 naga.
profile:
Barion, 31. A brash adventurer who has slain four dragons.
His axe carries the scars of every hunt.
